page.layout: One printed page, one text column with a left-hand year column in the table below, and line numbers (5 to 35) in the right margin. Top left, a marginal "An.M." beside the running head "BIBLICUS." and page number 471 at top right. Below the text, the signature "Gg 4" and the catchword "&in" at the foot.

main_text.p: An.M.stoli, & postea Græci, & Latini Patres ante Hieronymum. Resp. 1. Nullum concilium potest vel debet aliquid statuere contra Hebraicam veritatem. 2. Editio LXX. Interpretum ita est approbata ab ecclesiâ, vt tamen mendæ librariorum non 5sint canonizatæ. 3. Christus & apostoli sanctificarunt ista verba, quæ citarunt ex LXX. Interpretatione, non verò totum systema approbarunt. 4. Patres Græci & Latini, qui sequuntur chronologiam LXX. Interpretum, errant. 10
main_text.head: Secundum interuallum, à diluuio vsque ad promissionem Abrahamo factam.
main_text.l: 1656. | Mense primo huius anni Noah egressus est ex ar-15ca. Gen.8.v.13.
1757. | Peleg, filius Heber, nascitur. Gen.11.v.16. Hic no-20men habuit à diuisione: quia diuisio linguarum Gen.11.v.7. sub illo contigit.
1948. | Abraham, filius Tharah, nascitur, anno 70[?]. Tharah. Gen.11.v.26.
main_text.p: In hoc interuallo rursus est discrepantia inter codicem authenticum, qui est veritatis Hebraicæ, & codices Græcos LXX. Interpretum. Nam in35 primâ generatione vtrique codices conueniunt,

page.notes: The page is a single text column with marginal line numbers in the right margin. The marginal "An.M." at top left is treated as a left-margin note. In the year table, the name "Semi" in 1658 is doubtful (the print looks like "Scini"). The age "70" in 1948 is printed with a symbol after the 7 that I could not identify. The first word "stoli" is printed with a long s that I have read as s. The final line "prima" has a faint mark after the "m" that may be a printer's ligature or damage.
